implementationCoverage.assessment: The deterministic SVG prototype covers the main English semantic sequence, frame windows and Replay, but is explicitly legacy-prototype, has no canonical strict module/evidence, no external formula-shell audio, and no complete bilingual host behavior.
implementationCoverage.knownTextMismatch: The prototype uses one space after '=' in the Spanish formula; the embedded SWF string is '1 galón =  128 onzas líquidas' with two spaces. Preserve as a source discrepancy until text bounds and authoritative runtime rendering are reviewed.

standaloneRuffleLanguageProbe.result: Terminal PNGs were byte-identical, so standalone parameter injection did not create the required host-root dynamic text field.
standaloneRuffleLanguageProbe.implication: Standalone Ruffle is not an authoritative bilingual baseline; original-shell or Adobe Animate/Test Movie evidence is required.
